domain-information: A Business Owner submits monthly sales documents so the financial records stay up to date.
A Business Owner approves a large expense to allow the bookkeeper to process it.
A Business Owner sends supporting documents to an auditor upon request.
An Accountant reviews the submitted sales documents to prepare accurate financial entries.
An Accountant creates an invoice for a client to ensure the business gets paid.
A Bookkeeper records a new expense in the system so costs remain properly tracked.
A Bookkeeper categorizes recent receipts to keep the accounts organized.
A Bookkeeper notifies the accountant about a missing receipt to resolve an inconsistency.
An Auditor examines recent financial statements of an owner to verify they comply with regulations.
An Auditor requests supporting documents to clarify unusual transactions.
An Auditor finalizes the review so the business owner receives confirmation of compliance.

domain objects.name: Business Owner
domain objects.description: Person responsible for submitting records and approving financial actions.

domain objects.name: Monthly Sales Document
domain objects.description: Report showing sales activity for a given month.

domain objects.name: Expense
domain objects.description: Cost incurred by the business that must be recorded.

domain objects.name: Accountant
domain objects.description: Professional who prepares entries, reviews data, and manages invoices.

domain objects.name: Account
domain objects.description: Financial record containing entries, owner details, and receipts.

domain objects.name: Financial Entry
domain objects.description: Recorded financial transaction created from business documents.

domain objects.name: Receipt
domain objects.description: Proof of purchase used to validate expenses.

domain objects.name: Invoice
domain objects.description: Billing document issued to a client for services or products.

domain objects.name: Client
domain objects.description: Customer who receives invoices and pays the business.

domain objects.name: Bookkeeper
domain objects.description: Person who records expenses and organizes receipts.

domain objects.name: Inconsistency Notification
domain objects.description: Message alerting the accountant about missing or conflicting data.

domain objects.name: Auditor
domain objects.description: Independent reviewer ensuring financial statements meet regulations.

domain objects.name: Financial Statement
domain objects.description: Formal report summarizing the business’s financial performance.

domain objects.name: Regulations
domain objects.description: Financial rules and standards the business must follow.

domain objects.name: Document Request
domain objects.description: Request from the auditor to obtain additional documentation.

domain objects.name: Supporting Document
domain objects.description: Additional evidence provided to verify financial transactions.

domain objects.name: Finance Review
domain objects.description: Final assessment confirming compliance with financial rules.

associations.description: Business Owner submits Monthly Sales Documents.
Business Owner authorizes or creates Expenses.
Accountant updates the Account with financial entries.
Invoice is issued to the Client.
Client is connected to the Business Owner as the service provider.
Inconsistency Notification is sent to the Accountant.
Document Request is returned to the Auditor.
Business Owner receives the Finance Review.
